intent: Choose which model an agent or chat uses: grouped by vendor, with context window and cost tier, recommended models, and disabled models that keep their reason. Built on kit DropdownMenu.
useWhen: pick a model for an agent, chat or run
compare context window and cost at a glance
show models the plan does not include, with the reason
doNotUseWhen: a plain list of strings — Select
free search over many values — Combobox

models.note: { id, name, vendor?, description?, contextWindow?, costTier?, tagline?, disabled?, disabledReason?, recommended? }[]

requirements: a visible label (or hideLabel) names the field trigger
the menu is the kit DropdownMenu: groups with headings, arrow keys, Escape
disabled models stay in the list with their reason and a lock
error is role=alert and described by the trigger

doNot: Do not invent a local ModelSelect or ModelMenu
Do not hide unavailable models; disable them with a reason
